scripts.build:guests: cargo build -p hello -p crash -p catfile --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && mkdir -p packages/host/guests && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/hello.wasm target/wasm32-wasip1/release/crash.wasm target/wasm32-wasip1/release/catfile.wasm packages/host/guests/
scripts.build: npm run build:kernel && npm run binder gen
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p kernel --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run binder:kernel-check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:rust && npm run test:host && npm run test:e2e
